column1: # Third-party attribution manifest -- read by AttributionTest.
# path (under src/main/java) <TAB> kind <TAB> marker that must appear in the file's leading
# block comment.  kind: DERIVED | PORTED | PARTIAL | ORIGINAL | NOT_DERIVED.
# NOT_DERIVED is the explicit allow-list: P300's own code, no upstream notice required. It must
# still be LISTED -- adding a source file with no row here FAILS the build, which is what stops
# a new derived file slipping in unattributed.
